travel_time_formulation: t = (3.6 * length_m / 60 km/h) * citywide_TTI(hour); TTI relative to workbook 60 km/h free-flow reference (not OSM class free-flow × TTI).
unit_note: Observed times from workbook minutes after correcting Excel milli-minute artifacts (values>180 divided by 1000, not 60).
claim: Sunday OD durations predicted with Mon–Sat-only citywide TTI on a 60 km/h TTI-consistent free-flow baseline. Does not claim edge calibration or identical Waze/OSM routes. No Sunday tuning.
